'''Gane Klisson''' was a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] in the [[White Maw]] who lived on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="TOR:HP" /> During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Klisson led an attack on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]'s [[Outpost Zerek]], which was defeated.<ref name="TOR:WMAOZ">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|White Maw Assault: Outpost Zerek|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref>

Klison was eventually [[Mission to Hoth (Third Galactic War)|killed]] by the [[Alliance Commander]] during dealings with the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Greb Besrik]], during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:HP" />
